description: The bar chart illustrates the macro f-score performance of two models—RECA (light orange) and GAIT_GAT (dark orange)—across three frequency categories: High (implied by the unlabeled first group), Medium, and Low, as indicated on the horizontal axis labeled “Frequency.” The vertical axis, labeled “Macro f-score,” ranges from 0 to 1 in increments of 0.1, with gridlines aiding visual interpretation. For the High-frequency group (leftmost, unlabeled), RECA achieves a macro f-score of 0.837 and GAIT_GAT achieves 0.877. In the Medium-frequency group, RECA scores 0.538 and GAIT_GAT scores 0.609. In the Low-frequency group, RECA scores 0.114 and GAIT_GAT scores 0.224. Across all frequency levels, GAIT_GAT consistently outperforms RECA, with the performance gap widening as frequency decreases. The legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding: light orange for RECA and dark orange for GAIT_GAT. The chart visually emphasizes the models’ declining performance with lower data frequency, while highlighting GAIT_GAT’s relative robustness in low-resource settings.
